courses.overview: 由網路可觀察性、協議解碼與告警品質連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect network visibility, protocol decoding and alert quality to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 安全資訊事件管理
related.why: 可移植「觀察點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from observation points; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「觀察點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from observation points; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理網路可觀察性、協議解碼與告警品質；「安全資訊事件管理」主要處理日誌正規化、事件關聯與可用性，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes network visibility, protocol decoding and alert quality; Security information and event management emphasizes log normalization, event correlation and availability. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「網路入侵偵測工程」與「安全資訊事件管理」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「協議解碼」的對照方法至「時區與偏差」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Network intrusion-detection engineering and Security information and event management flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from protocol decoding to timezone and skew, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 安全網頁應用程式防護
related.why: 可移植「觀察點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from observation points; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「觀察點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from observation points; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理網路可觀察性、協議解碼與告警品質；「安全網頁應用程式防護」主要處理應用控制、防護規則與正常流量驗證，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes network visibility, protocol decoding and alert quality; Web-application protection systems emphasizes application controls, protection rules and benign-traffic validation. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「網路入侵偵測工程」與「安全網頁應用程式防護」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「協議解碼」的對照方法至「規則範圍」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Network intrusion-detection engineering and Web-application protection systems flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from protocol decoding to rule scopes, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
